label: Amazon S3 backup destination
summary: Prepare a scoped remote backup destination with explicit retention and recovery qualification.
core_boundary: Baseline local backup and restore remain free Core functions; object storage is an optional destination, not the only recovery path. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Bind account, region, bucket and managed object prefix to one admitted backup policy.
Qualify encryption-key recovery, versioning and any immutable-retention capability before claiming protection.
Restore a verified recovery point on a clean target and refuse deletion outside the owned backup prefix.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
